correctness.rationale: The height-one Cayley polytope conv((aΔ3,0),(bΔ3,1)) has integral slices at t=j of kP of size binomial(a(k-j)+bj+3,3). The exact k+1 term sum and fourth-order finite difference derive the asserted h1,h2,h3 coefficients and h4=0 by width-one interior-point obstruction. With X=a-1,Y=b-1, the h_i are explicit positive polynomials (except degree-drop h3). For X+Y=0, h*=1+3z; for X+Y=1, h*=1+9z+5z² with positive discriminant 61. Otherwise the cubic discriminant satisfies an exact identity 432D=Σ c_ij X^iY^j with 90 strictly positive nonzero coefficients, including linear coefficients 7776 each, hence D>0 on integer X+Y>=2; all three roots are distinct real and negative because coefficients are positive. Independent SymPy computation from the h_i formulas reproduces exactly 90 positive coefficients, c_10=c_01=7776 and constant zero. Six facets, primitive edge-direction determinants ±1 at each vertex and integral height coordinate show smoothness and lattice width one.
